sum: Alico, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an agricultural land leasing and land development company in the United States. It engages in the farming, grazing and hunting leasing, and conservation of native pastureland, as well as mining and other royalties, and other ancillary activities. The company was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Fort Myers, Florida.
ceo: Mr. John E. Kiernan Esq. (President, CEO & Director)
